items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) did not practice for the second straight day. McVay says not long-term but team being cautious; may miss Sunday.
items.why: Hip injury; limited progress per McVay.
items.implication: High risk of missing Week 3; Adams primary beneficiary on routes/targets.
items.opportunity: Davante Adams 142 routes/42% target rate without Nacua historically; strong production in prior absences.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) did not practice for the second straight day and is likely to miss a second consecutive game vs Colts.
items.implication: Expect OUT; elevates TE Dalton Schultz targets/routes.
items.opportunity: Schultz 30% routes targeted and 28% team target share without Collins; Colts allow 4th-most TE yards.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) on practice field after good MRI; expects to play Monday vs Bears. Limited participant Thursday.
items.why: Good MRI results; suited up and practicing.
items.implication: Start with confidence if active; reverse prior handcuff buzz for Bigsby/Shipley.
items.opportunity: Full workload likely if clears; backups limited too.

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Puka Nacua as a Ram, targeted on 60 (42%). Results in two missed games: 5-35-3 and 8-195-2.
items.why: Historical route/target data when Nacua sidelined; McVay cautious on Nacua hip.
items.implication: Adams elite WR1 upside if Nacua out again; prioritize in lineups/DFS.
items.opportunity: 42% target rate and big production spikes without Nacua.

items.text: 10 Facts: Schultz 30% routes/28% target share sans Collins + Colts TE-friendly; London averages 20+ PPR/35% share/97 yds in 12 games with Penix. Lloyd 38% snaps/10.5 touches (red zone = Brooks).
items.why: Concrete usage averages and shares from recent games/absences.
items.implication: Schultz TE1 streamer if Collins out; London smash with Penix; Lloyd committee but not zero.
items.opportunity: High target/route shares in expanded roles; Penix-London chemistry proven.

items.text: Zay Flowers first hurt hamstring Aug 20 joint practice; fine for Week 1 (5-150-1 first half) then aggravated; no full practice since. Ravens to Brazil.
items.implication: High miss probability Week 3; fade or bench.

items.text: Panthers RB Jonathon Brooks undergoes core muscle surgery, placed on IR; out at least 6 weeks.
items.implication: Chuba Hubbard locked as lead back; AJ Dillon primary backup.
items.opportunity: Hubbard RB14 utilization through 2 weeks; clear volume bump ROS short-term.

items.text: Comprehensive hurt list: WRs/TEs/QBs include Nacua, Collins, Bowers, AJ Brown, Flowers, Daniels, Caleb Williams, Dart, Reed, etc. RBs: Brooks, Dowdle, Mason (meh committees).
items.implication: Prioritize status checks; beneficiaries in those offenses.
items.opportunity: Role expansions for healthy teammates (e.g. Adams, Schultz, Hubbard).

items.text: TNF questions: Has Marshawn Lloyd ceded backfield to Kaleb Johnson? Penix healthy enough to revive London/Pitts? Reed absence more 2-TE for Packers? OL hold for Watson/Golden?
items.why: Pre-TNF usage/role uncertainty based on recent snaps/health.
items.implication: London/Pitts upside with Penix; monitor Lloyd snap share drop; Watson elevated without Reed.
items.opportunity: Penix-London historical 20+ PPR/35% share/97 yds; 2-TE boosts Kraft etc.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop (88.5); Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup vs weak run D + high prop.
items.opportunity: Dallas poor vs run; Henry workhorse.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% target share both games; RB7 utilization (86); PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
items.why: Volume + deep threat vs soft secondary.
items.implication: WR2/3 with WR1 upside this week.

items.text: Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX: 31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble last week; JAX allows only 55 rush yds/g and 3.2 YPC to RBs. (Note: Henderson led post-fumble at 65% snaps).
items.why: Role diminished post-fumble + tough matchup; still ranks Stevenson ahead ROS/weekly per 10 Facts but gap narrowed.
items.implication: Sit/fade Stevenson; Henderson more positive but not full takeover (pass pro concerns).
items.conflict: Berry still ranks Stevenson ahead of Henderson Week 3 despite usage shift.
